zh:
歌手 6（這個角色視為費用 6 來詠唱歌曲。）
很美，對吧？　當你打出這個角色時，你可以免費打出一首費用 6 或以下的歌。

name: Vanellope von Schweetz - Sugar Rush Princess
en:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Vanellope von Schweetz.)
I HEREBY DECREE Whenever you play another
Princess character, all opposing characters get -1 ¤
until the start of your next turn.
zh:
變身 2（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Vanellope von Schweetz 的角色上。）
我在此宣布　每當你打出另一個公主角色時，所有對方角色獲得 -1 ¤，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Revive
en:
Play a character with cost 5 or less from your
discard for free.
zh: 從你的棄牌堆免費打出一個費用 5 或以下的角色。

name: Archimedes - Electrified Owl
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Archimedes.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
this character.)
Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character
gets +3 ¤.)
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Archimedes 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
挑戰者 +3（挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +3 ¤。）

name: Olaf - Happy Passenger
en:
CLEAR THE PATH For each exerted character
opponents have in play, you pay 1 ⬡ less to
play this character.
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh:
清出道路　你每有一個對方橫置的角色在場，你打出這個角色時就少支付 1 ⬡。
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Finders Keepers
en: Draw 3 cards.
zh: 抽 3 張牌。

name: Clarabelle - Light on Her Hooves
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Clarabelle.)
KEEP IN STEP At the end of your turn, if chosen
opponent has more cards in their hand than you, you
may draw cards until you have the same number.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Clarabelle 的角色上。）
保持同步　在你的回合結束時，若指定對手手牌比你多，你可以抽牌直到你手牌數量與他相同。

name: Scar - Vengeful Lion
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
LIFE'S NOT FAIR, IS IT? Whenever one of your
characters challenges a damaged character,
you may draw a card.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
人生不公平，對吧？　每當你一個角色挑戰一個受傷角色時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: You're Welcome
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Shuffle chosen character, item, or location into
their player's deck. That player draws 2 cards.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將指定的角色、物品或地點洗回其持有者的牌庫。該玩家抽兩張牌。

name: Donald Duck - Pie Slinger
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Donald Duck.)
HUMBLE PIE When you play this character, if you used
Shift to play him, each opponent loses 2 lore.
RAGING DUCK While an opponent has 10 or more lore,
this character gets +6 ¤.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Donald Duck 的角色上。）
謙卑派　當你打出這個角色時，若你以變身打出他，每位對手失去 2 點傳說值。
狂怒之鴨　當有對手有 10 點或以上的傳說值時，這個角色獲得 +6 ¤。

name: Robin Hood - Sharpshooter
en:
MY GREATEST PERFORMANCE Whenever this
character quests, look at the top 4 cards of
your deck. You may reveal an action card with
cost 6 or less and play it for free. Put the rest
in your discard.
zh: 我最精彩的表演　每當這個角色探險時，查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示一張費用 6 或以下的行動卡並免費打出它。將其餘的放入你的棄牌堆。

name: Ratigan's Party - Seedy Back Room
en:
MISFITS' REVELRY While you have a damaged character here, this
location gets +2 ◊.
zh: 邊緣人的狂歡　當你這裡有一個受傷的角色時，這個地點獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Mufasa - Ruler of Pride Rock
en:
A DELICATE BALANCE When you play this character,
exert all cards in your inkwell, then return 2 cards at
random from your inkwell to your hand.
EVERYTHING THE LIGHT TOUCHES Whenever this
character quests, ready all cards in your inkwell.
zh:
微妙的平衡　當你打出這個角色時，橫置你墨水池中所有卡，然後隨機從你的墨水池將 2 張卡移回你的手牌。
陽光照耀的一切　每當這個角色探險時，準備你墨水池中所有卡。

name: King Candy - Sweet Abomination
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named King Candy.)
CHANGING THE CODE When you play this
character, you may draw 2 cards, then put a card
from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 King Candy 的角色上。）
更改代碼　當你打出這個角色時，你可以抽兩張牌，然後將一張手牌放到你牌庫底。

name: Royal Tantrum
en:
Banish any number of your items, then draw a card
for each item banished this way.
zh: 消滅你任意數量的物品，然後以此方式每消滅一個物品就抽一張牌。

name: Snow White - Fair-Hearted
en:
NATURAL LEADER This character gains Resist +1
for each other Knight character you have in play.
(Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1
for each other Knight.)
zh: 天生的領袖　你在場每有一個其他騎士角色，這個角色就獲得抵抗 +1。（每有一個其他騎士，對這個角色造成的傷害就減少 1。）

name: Arthur - King Victorious
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Arthur.)
KNIGHTED BY THE KING When you play this character,
chosen character gains Challenger +2 and Resist +2 and
can challenge ready characters this turn. (They get +2 ¤
while challenging. Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Arthur 的角色上。）
受國王冊封　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2 和抵抗 +2，並可以挑戰已準備的角色。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Bad-Anon - Villain Support Center
en:
THERE'S NO ONE I'D RATHER BE THAN ME Villain characters gain “⟳, 3 ⬡ —
Play a character with the same name as this character for free” while here.
zh: 沒人比我更想當我自己　反派角色在這裡時獲得「⟳，3 ⬡ — 免費打出一個與這個角色同名的角色」。

name: Half Hexwell Crown
en:
AN UNEXPECTED FIND ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Draw a card.
A PERILOUS POWER ⟳, 2 ⬡, Discard a card — Exert
chosen character.
zh:
意外的發現　⟳，2 ⬡ — 抽一張牌。
危險的力量　⟳，2 ⬡，棄掉一張卡 — 橫置指定角色。
